references.text: Here God's great works and his holy name are mentioned, which reflects Mary's song of praise about God's great works and holy name in Luke 1:49.
This verse highlights God's great works and his holy name, paralleling Mary's acknowledgment of God's great works and holy name in Luke 1:49.
Jeremiah speaks of God's great works, which is reflected in Mary's song of praise about God's great works in Luke 1:49.
Mary's song of praise (Magnificat) in its entirety, where Luke 1:49 is a part, reflects on God's great works and holy name.
